info.title: Pingo Notify API | v3.0.0
info.description: Pingo Notify v3 REST API. Connect WhatsApp (unofficial via Evolution and the official WhatsApp Cloud API), send and receive messages, manage workspaces and run a full multi-agent Helpdesk. Authenticate with an API token in the `apikey` header (`apikey: sk_live_...`). Use the optional `X-Account-Id` header to act on a specific workspace.

post.description: PUBLIC. Inbound HTTP entry point for the headless API channel. Auth is the channel's HMAC signature (`x-helpdesk-signature` header over the raw JSON body), validated at this boundary. Accepts JSON or multipart/form-data with inline attachments. accountId is derived from the inbox.

parameters.name: x-helpdesk-signature
parameters.description: HMAC signature of the raw JSON body (required when the channel enforces HMAC).

ApiKeyAuth.name: apikey
ApiKeyAuth.description: API token. Send as `apikey: sk_live_<token>` (or `sk_test_<token>` for test mode).

AccountIdHeader.name: X-Account-Id
AccountIdHeader.description: Optional workspace selector. When omitted, the caller's personal/default workspace is used. A workspace the caller does not belong to yields 403.

AcctActiveAccount.description: The active workspace context resolved for the request.

AcctApiToken.description: An API token with the secret masked (only the last 4 chars).

AcctApiTokenWithSecret.description: An API token including the full plaintext `token` — returned ONLY on create and on rotation (refreshToken=true).

token.description: Full plaintext token, e.g. sk_live_<secret>. Shown only once.

AcctBillingOverview.description: Plan/usage, subscription and wallet balance for a workspace.

AcctCreateOauthApp.description: New OAuth app payload. All fields optional per the validator.

accountId.description: Optional target workspace. When set, the caller must be OWNER or ADMIN of it.

AcctInvitation.description: A pending invitation addressed to the caller.

AcctInviteMember.description: Invite payload. Roles must be below your own; OWNER cannot be granted.

AcctMember.description: An account membership row with the embedded user summary.

AcctMemberRoles.description: Workspace-level role. OWNER (one per account), ADMIN, MANAGER, AGENT.

AcctMemberRow.description: An account membership row (no embedded user).

AcctMemberUser.description: Embedded user summary for a membership.

AcctOauthApp.description: An OAuth app (safe fields only; the app token is never exposed).

AcctOauthAppCreateResult.description: Result of creating an OAuth app: the safe app fields plus a one-time access code.

userId.description: The member who becomes the new account owner (must already be a member).

AcctUpdateApiToken.description: API token update. Set refreshToken to rotate the secret.

refreshToken.description: When true, rotates the token and returns a new plaintext secret once.

AcctWorkspaceListItem.description: A workspace the caller can operate on, with their roles and helpdesk flag.

ChatButton.description: An interactive button. Extra fields depend on `type` (copy → copyCode; url → url; call → phoneNumber; pix → currency/name/keyType/key).

ChatDownloadMediaResponse.description: Decrypted media payload for a message.

ChatItem.description: A chat (conversation) summary with its session window state and last message.

ChatMediaData.description: Inline media descriptor for an outbound message.

ChatSendEvolutionResponse.description: Raw send acknowledgement returned for template, list and button messages.

ChatSendMessageResponse.description: Persisted outbound message record (text, media, sticker and voice audio).

encoding.description: Whether the audio should be re-encoded to OPUS.

id.description: Media ID obtained via the Media Upload API.

parameter_name.description: Used when the template has named parameters.

numbers.description: Phone numbers to verify (E.164 digits, no plus sign).

ConnConnection.description: A WhatsApp connection scoped to the active workspace.

status.description: Live connection status (e.g. open, close, connecting).

ConnCreateConnectionRequest.description: Payload to create a connection. Meta fields are required only when type is WHATSAPP_OFFICIAL.

qrcode.description: Request a pairing QR code (unofficial connections).

metaAccessToken.description: Meta Cloud API access token. Required when type is WHATSAPP_OFFICIAL.

metaPhoneNumberId.description: Meta phone number ID (digits only). Required when type is WHATSAPP_OFFICIAL.

metaBusinessAccountId.description: Meta WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) ID (digits only). Required when type is WHATSAPP_OFFICIAL.

metaAppSecret.description: Optional Meta app secret. When provided, enables HMAC x-hub-signature-256 verification on inbound webhooks. Only used for WHATSAPP_OFFICIAL.

ConnCreateConnectionResponse.description: Serialized create-connection response: the connection plus its pairing QR code.

ConnCreateTemplateRequest.description: Payload to create a WhatsApp message template. The components array is a discriminated union (on type) of BODY and BUTTONS components.

ConnMetaTemplate.description: A WhatsApp message template as returned by the Meta Graph API (shape passed through verbatim).

ConnQrcode.description: Pairing QR code data for an unofficial connection.

base64.description: Data-URI PNG of the QR code.

ConnSettings.description: Baileys (unofficial) instance behavior settings. All flags optional.

ConnTemplate.description: Locally registered template returned after creation.

template.description: The Meta template payload as created.

body_text.description: Sample variable values for the body placeholders.

ConnTemplateButton.description: A template button. URL buttons additionally require a url.

HdConvCreateMessage.description: Create a message. All fields optional; attachments/template/content drive the message type.

localSourceId.description: Optimistic correlation token; echoed in HTTP+WS

body.description: BODY component text for quick preview

HdConvSendTemplate.description: HSM template in the official Cloud API shape.

inboundWebhookSecret.description: One-shot inbound webhook secret — returned only on creation.

rrPosition.description: Position in the round-robin assignment order.

HdInboxWorkingHourSlot.description: Inline working-hours slot embedded in the inbox response.

HdOpsAgentOverviewRow.description: Per-agent report row. Tempos em segundos; null = sem amostra.

HdOpsCreateSlaPolicyBody.description: At least one threshold must be provided (validated server-side).

subscriptions.description: Unique list of subscribed event types.

signingSecret.description: Override only; omitted = service generates a random secret.
